meaning: to stroll aimlessly, to wander leisurely
example: Le dimanche, j'aime flâner dans le Marais sans but précis.
exampleTranslation: On Sundays, I like to wander aimlessly through the Marais.

example: Ce mec est un peu chelou, non ?
exampleTranslation: That guy is a bit shady, isn't he?

example: Je kiffe trop ce petit resto du 11e.
exampleTranslation: I really love this little restaurant in the 11th.

example: J'ai eu une grosse journée de boulot.
exampleTranslation: I had a heavy day at work.

example: Elle bosse dans une agence de pub.
exampleTranslation: She works at an ad agency.

example: Passe-moi le truc sur la table.
exampleTranslation: Pass me the thing on the table.

example: C'était grave bien, cette soirée.
exampleTranslation: That party was really great.

example: On se fait un apéro en terrasse ce soir ?
exampleTranslation: Shall we grab drinks on the terrace tonight?

meaning: to go for a walk, to wander
example: On s'est baladés le long de la Seine.
exampleTranslation: We wandered along the Seine.

example: C'est un mec super sympa.
exampleTranslation: He's a really nice guy.

example: La meuf au comptoir, c'est ma cousine.
exampleTranslation: The girl at the counter is my cousin.

example: Mets ton manteau, ça caille dehors !
exampleTranslation: Put your coat on, it's freezing outside!

meaning: to treat oneself to a meal out
example: Ce soir, on se tape un resto, c'est moi qui invite.
exampleTranslation: Tonight we're eating out, my treat.

example: Après le déménagement, j'étais complètement crevé.
exampleTranslation: After the move, I was completely wiped out.

example: J'adore l'ambiance de mon quartier.
exampleTranslation: I love the vibe of my neighborhood.

example: Le 10e est devenu super bobo.
exampleTranslation: The 10th has become really hipster-bourgeois.

example: On se voit à 19h ? — Ça marche !
exampleTranslation: See each other at 7? — Sounds good!

example: Un café serré, s'il vous plaît.
exampleTranslation: A strong espresso, please.

example: Je file, je suis en retard !
exampleTranslation: I'm dashing off, I'm late!

example: On adore chiner aux Puces de Saint-Ouen.
exampleTranslation: We love bargain-hunting at the Saint-Ouen flea market.

meaning: a glass of wine (Parisian café slang)
example: On se prend un canon de rouge ?
exampleTranslation: Shall we grab a glass of red?

meaning: to struggle, to have a hard time
example: Je galère à trouver un appart à Paris.
exampleTranslation: I'm struggling to find a flat in Paris.

meaning: a plan / a tip / a deal
example: J'ai un bon plan pour dîner pas cher.
exampleTranslation: I've got a good tip for a cheap dinner.

example: Ton appart est nickel !
exampleTranslation: Your flat is spotless!

example: J'ai plus une thune avant la paie.
exampleTranslation: I'm broke until payday.

meaning: much the same, all the same
example: Métro ou bus, pour moi c'est kif-kif.
exampleTranslation: Metro or bus, it's all the same to me.

example: Arrête de déconner, sois sérieux deux minutes.
exampleTranslation: Stop messing around, be serious for a sec.

example: J'ai la flemme de sortir ce soir.
exampleTranslation: I can't be bothered to go out tonight.

meaning: to show up, to turn up
example: Il s'est pointé avec deux heures de retard.
exampleTranslation: He showed up two hours late.

example: L'expo était un truc de ouf.
exampleTranslation: The exhibition was something crazy.

example: Je sors avec des potes ce week-end.
exampleTranslation: I'm going out with mates this weekend.

example: Je dois taffer ce dimanche, malheureusement.
exampleTranslation: I have to work this Sunday, unfortunately.
